summary: Master conflict resolution with our comprehensive training course. Equip yourself with tools to manage disputes and improve team dynamics effectively.
lede: Workplace conflict management gives team leaders, supervisors and employee-relations professionals a structured way to address disagreement. Learners practise identifying conflict causes and styles, regulating responses, and using active listening and interest-based negotiation to prepare difficult conversations. Exercises include creating conflict diagnosis maps, conversation guides, action plans and follow-up records that help managers track agreed next steps.
audienceIntro: This conflict management training is designed for professionals who handle tension, disagreement, and difficult conversations in real workplace settings. It is suitable for people who need practical tools for resolving disputes, improving team relationships, and documenting outcomes that can be followed up by managers or HR.
prerequisites: No formal qualification is required. A working understanding of team dynamics, workplace communication, or people management is helpful. You do not need coding or software skills, but you should be ready to work through case scenarios, complete self-assessments, and draft practical workplace documents such as a conflict map, a resolution plan, and a difficult-conversation guide.
